note: WORK-UX-01: one role per layer, and the actions each role performs. An action carries its own setup (instructions, what it always reads, what it may change, tools, what it asks first, run phases) and the checks its work is reviewed against. Projects copy these defaults into revisioned `role` and `work_action` records and change them from Work › Roles. `type` is the work type the runner and guidance know. `routine` names the config/routines.json routine whose items this action takes. The exact tools and permissions per action are a first cut; the owner expects to refine them. ROADMAP-01 (DEC-043): an action marked `elevated` (the shield) is for leads of its role only; an agent given one acts as a lead for it, and its result waits for a human lead. Every role reviews its own work with its `review` action.

presets.note: Onboarding working styles only seed who takes each action. `agent` means the default agent profile; anything else goes to the person who created the project. They are never shown again.

roles.name: Product lead
roles.blurb: Shapes what to build and why: stories, acceptance and specs.
roles.instructions: Write for the personas in Product › Vision. Ask only questions whose answers change what gets built.

actions.name: Write acceptance
actions.description: Given/When/Then for stories that have none
actions.instructions: Each scenario must be checkable in a preview. Cover the open edges listed on the story.
actions.asks: Changing a story's title or phase
checks: Each scenario can be checked in a preview
The scenarios cover the story's open edges

actions.name: Draft answers to open questions
actions.description: Options and a recommendation; a person decides
actions.instructions: Offer two to four answers that differ in ways the owner cares about, and recommend one.
actions.asks: Always: the decision is a person's
checks: The answer is applied to the record it changes

actions.name: Change the Brief
actions.description: Add, edit or remove Brief claims
actions.instructions: Every claim is short and checkable. Mark what it rests on; don't restate evidence as fact.
actions.asks: Removing a claim other records rely on
checks: Each claim is one short, checkable statement

actions.name: Move stories between milestones
actions.description: Changes what ships when
checks: The milestone's exit criteria still hold

actions.name: Shape project briefs
actions.description: Problem, appetite, solution and numbered requirements for a project
actions.instructions: One spec per increment of related stories. Number requirements; use WHEN clauses where a requirement is conditional.
actions.asks: Changing a phase or the roadmap
checks: Every requirement traces to a story
The appetite is stated

actions.name: Research
actions.description: Sources, findings and insights, attached where they are used
actions.instructions: Cite primary sources with the date you read them.
checks: Each claim cites a source

actions.name: Product drift check
actions.description: Built behaviour against acceptance
actions.instructions: List stories whose built behaviour and acceptance disagree.
checks: Each finding names the story it concerns

actions.name: Review Vision work
actions.description: Accept or send back results from this role
actions.instructions: Check each result against its checks and the records it changed. Send back with a note on what is wrong.
checks: Each verdict quotes its evidence

roles.name: Design lead
roles.blurb: Keeps the design system coherent across every page.
roles.instructions: Propose new components rather than one-off styles.

actions.name: Evolve tokens and components
actions.description: New components rather than one-off styles
actions.asks: Changing a token more than one page uses
checks: Every page still reads well with the change

actions.name: Design system audit
actions.description: One-off styles and drift from tokens
checks: Each finding names the page it concerns

actions.name: Review Design work
actions.description: Accept or send back results from this role
actions.instructions: Check each result against its checks and the records it changed. Send back with a note on what is wrong.
checks: Each verdict quotes its evidence

roles.name: Experience designer
roles.blurb: Turns stories into pages and the flows between them.
roles.instructions: Design from the stories a page realises; every linked story gets a place.

actions.name: Design pages
actions.description: Every linked story gets a place on the page
actions.instructions: Use the project's tokens and components. Offer options only when they differ in ways the owner cares about.
actions.asks: Removing a story from a page
checks: Every linked story has a place on the page

actions.name: Explore page concepts
actions.description: New layouts and interaction models
actions.instructions: Offer two or three concepts that differ in ways the owner cares about.
checks: The concepts differ in ways that matter

actions.name: Map flows
actions.description: How pages connect for each activity
checks: Every activity can be completed through the pages

actions.name: Accessibility sweep
actions.description: Contrast, focus and labelling
checks: Each finding is recorded on its page

actions.name: Review Pages work
actions.description: Accept or send back results from this role
actions.instructions: Check each result against its checks and the records it changed. Send back with a note on what is wrong.
checks: Each verdict quotes its evidence

roles.name: Data architect
roles.blurb: Owns objects, operations and who may use them.
roles.instructions: Nothing above Platform names the stack. Objects are JSON Schema 2020-12; operations follow OpenAPI 3.1.

actions.name: Write object contracts
actions.description: Fields, required fields and states, with no stack names
actions.instructions: Required fields follow the stories that need them.
checks: The fields cover every story that needs the object
The contract names no tables, frameworks or languages

actions.name: Write API operations
actions.description: OpenAPI shape, errors and roles
checks: Each operation serves a story

actions.name: Set access rules
actions.description: Who may read and change each object
checks: Every object has a rule for each role

actions.name: Review Data work
actions.description: Accept or send back results from this role
actions.instructions: Check each result against its checks and the records it changed. Send back with a note on what is wrong.
checks: Each verdict quotes its evidence

roles.name: Engineer
roles.blurb: Builds stories, keeps the code in step with the layers, and owns the docs developers and agents read.
roles.instructions: Implement against the story's acceptance and the Data contract.

actions.name: Build stories
actions.description: One story per build; the preview must pass its acceptance
actions.instructions: One story per build. Name tests after the scenario they check ("S4/2 · …"; "S4 · …" for the whole story). Commit with the Aludel-Work and Implements trailers.
checks: The preview passes every acceptance scenario of the story

actions.name: Reconcile changed code
actions.description: Create, modify or remove code against the new revision
actions.instructions: Classify each linked unit as create, modify or remove against the new revision, then relink.
actions.asks: Removing a unit something still calls
checks: The code matches the record's new revision

actions.name: Refresh docs
actions.description: Rewrite doc sections whose sources changed; keep AGENTS.md a short map
actions.instructions: Update the section from its changed sources and cite them in docs/.aludel/sources.json. Keep AGENTS.md a short map into docs/.
actions.asks: Removing a doc something links to
checks: Every changed source is reflected in the section
The section's sources are recorded

actions.name: Update dependencies
actions.description: Versions and what changed
checks: Tests pass after the update

actions.name: Security audit
actions.description: Findings for this release
checks: Each finding has a severity and the record it concerns

actions.name: Review Code work
actions.description: Accept or send back results from this role
actions.instructions: Check each result against its checks and the records it changed. Send back with a note on what is wrong.
checks: Each verdict quotes its evidence

roles.name: Operator
roles.blurb: Runs the app: environments, releases in and out, variables, integrations and data.
roles.instructions: Say what an operation affects, what it costs and how to undo it. Take a backup before anything touches data.

actions.name: Configure services
actions.description: Name the effect, its cost and whether it can be undone
checks: The cost and how to undo it are stated

actions.name: Promote a release
actions.description: Run a release that passed in one environment in the next
actions.instructions: Promote the image that already passed; never rebuild. Back up the database first and list pending migrations.
checks: A backup was taken first
Pending migrations were listed

actions.name: Roll back
actions.description: Run an earlier release again
actions.instructions: Run the earlier release's image after a backup. Say which data changes it cannot undo.
checks: The environment is healthy afterwards

actions.name: Review Deploy work
actions.description: Accept or send back results from this role
actions.instructions: Check each result against its checks and the environments it changed. Send back with a note on what is wrong.
checks: Every check has a verdict

roles.name: Project lead
roles.blurb: Plans the work: projects, dates, dependencies and batches, and signs projects off.
roles.instructions: Keep projects small and sequenced. Dates are for work with real timeframes; agent work is capped by budget.

actions.name: Create and shape projects
actions.description: Brief, stories and checkpoints
actions.instructions: One project per increment of related work. Name the problem, the stories and what it rules out.
checks: Every requirement traces to a story
The appetite is stated

actions.name: Set dates, budgets and dependencies
actions.description: The timeline and spend caps
changes: Work › project dates, budgets and dependencies
checks: No project starts before one it depends on ends

actions.name: Milestone check
actions.description: Exit criteria and what is slipping
actions.instructions: List projects past their target date or budget, and stories the milestone needs that aren't built.
checks: Each finding names the project it concerns

actions.name: Final project review
actions.description: A project’s preview against all its stories
actions.instructions: For each check: look at its evidence, compare it with the check's source record, and say pass or flag with the evidence you used.
checks: Each verdict quotes its evidence
